property_summary: For any caller and any block, if the caller is a receiver whose fallback reverts, then a successful 10-ether fallback call must revert exactly when block.number % 15 == 0 (the payout transfer to the failing receiver reverts); the mutant deletes the payout, so the call always succeeds and this rule fails on divisible-by-15 blocks.
change_summary: Delete the payout statement so the contract never transfers its balance to the caller.
